commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' A terrific attempt by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
90+2' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:3.
86' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Abdel Abqar (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
84' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
82' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta departs the field of play to be replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is coming onto the pitch as Gorka Guruzeta cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) for Nico Williams.
76' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Andoni Gorosabel and he is replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
76' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
73' Ath Bilbao show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Guevara trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
70' That will be all from Samu Omorodion who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giuliano Simeone (Alaves).
70' Here is a change. Unai Gomez is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benat Prados Diaz as he is replaced by Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
69' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
63' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
58' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Luis Rioja is replaced by Ianis Hagi (Alaves).
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jon Guridi will be replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
57' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao).
54' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
48' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' A cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
42' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
37' 2 - 0 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
37' Attention! Referee Alejandro Ruiz straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
36' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' 1 - 0 Goal! Nico Williams plays a simple square pass into the feet of Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball inside the left post. 1:0.
31' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Unai Simon pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
31' Luis Rioja (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!

30' The game is interrupted. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Alaves!
29' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

25' Ath Bilbao slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
24' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
18' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
16' Unai Simon makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Jon Guridi (Alaves) after a cross from the side.
13' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.
11' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
9' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
6' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao).
6' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
5' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
4' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
2' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz is the one to supervise the game today.
